newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Efacec surges on talk of stake buying.
newsitem.headline: Efacec surges on talk of stake buying.

text.p: Shares of electrical engineering group Empresa Fabril de Maquinas Electricas (Efacec) rose 14 percent in the past week on talk of a stake accumulated by an institutional investor, thought to be linked to Banco Portugues de Investimento market sources said.
They also said the company was helped by the prospect of good results.
BPI declined comment while Efacec said it was unaware of a new investor.
Efacec hit a high for the year of 1,591 escudos and later eased to 1,565, up six, in volume of 365,977 at 1440 GMT.
"The activity of Efacec in recent sessions is linked to a buy recommendation by a domestic investment house. There is also talk of a new shareholder," a dealer said.
Ten percent of Efacec's share capital changed hands in the past week.
An analyst said: "If Efacec's profits exceed the expected level of one billion escudos in 1997, the share price will rise further."

The most conservative forecasts of analysts point to a net consolidated profit by Efacec of 1.0 billion escudos, excluding any extraordinary items, compared with 1.2 billion, including extraordinaries, in 1996.
